caption: The drawing depicts a round wooden object that appears to be a shield or a cover, colored in various shades of brown to represent wood grain. The main part of the object is a complete circle, with a decorative, slightly pointed, floral motif at the center, extending vertically above and below the horizontal axis. Across the upper portion of the circle, there is a horizontal bar with visible wood grain texture, attached with two metal hinges. A segment of the circular object in the lower left quadrant is decorated with scallop designs and appears as if a section of the main circle has been swung open, revealing additional detail underneath. The background is plain and light beige, and there are two signatures to the right and below the central object reading "FR. EBIKER" and "R. E. NOBLE."
title: Baptismal Font, Cover
